briefings.title: Fed's Kashkari Says War Creates Uncertainty for Rate Path (Full Interview from Invest)

people.name: Neel Kashkari
people.role: President, Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis

briefings.tldr: Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis President Neel Kashkari indicates that while inflation is generally trending toward the 2% target, new geopolitical uncertainties and tariff-related price pressures have complicated the path for interest rate cuts, leaving him with a projection of only one rate reduction for the remainder of the year.

briefings.title: War Creates Uncertainty for Rate Path Says Fed's  Kashkari  (Full Panel)

people.name: Neel Kashkari
people.role: President, Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis

briefings.tldr: Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari maintains a cautious outlook, signaling potentially only one interest rate cut in 2024 as geopolitical shocks and a resilient economy suggest the "neutral" interest rate may be higher than previously estimated.
